Yemen’s Houthis warned people to avoid Saudi airports after a Riyadh airport attack killed 12 people and injured more than 300 on Saturday.

The Houthis threatened stronger retaliation if Saudi Arabia continues its military strikes in Yemen.
Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz threatens to kill Hamas political chief Khalil al-Hayya. https://t.co/TwssPzPDOk

Pope Leo XIV, 71, announced he will undergo surgery after doctors discovered a small, well-localized nodule on his lung during a medical checkup.

The Pope said the nodule was detected at an early stage and is well-contained. 

Source: BBC https://t.co/EsfxRN7Jjj
